budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: Average 1-Star Hotel Price in Santiago, Chile: with data for 76 hotels, the average price for 1-star hotels is $62 and the median price is $57. The star-rating table also lists 1-star hotels at $62 before taxes and fees.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Santiago Chile 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: Accepted as an exact Santiago city-wide 1-star nightly statistic with a visible 76-hotel sample and USD currency. Occupancy remains source-default-room because the result does not establish a two-adult/one-room basis. The median is retained in evidence but was not averaged or substituted.
